job_terminal.name: job_terminal
job_terminal.value: not ("job"."done_at" is not null and "job"."failed_at" is not null)

consent_end_fields.name: consent_end_fields
consent_end_fields.value: ("consent_record"."ended_at" is null) = ("consent_record"."end_reason" is null) and ("consent_record"."ended_at" is null) = ("consent_record"."ended_by" is null)

account_display_name_len.name: account_display_name_len
account_display_name_len.value: "account"."display_name" is null or length("account"."display_name") between 1 and 120

media_purge_due.name: media_purge_due
media_purge_due.where: "media_asset"."purged_at" is not null and "media_asset"."object_deleted_at" is null

upload_terminal.name: upload_terminal
upload_terminal.value: not ("upload_session"."completed_at" is not null and "upload_session"."aborted_at" is not null)
